chapterInfo.content:
33
Wiase sodie ho dwom
1 # Dwom 32.11 Ateneneefoɔ, momfa anigyeɛ nhuro AWURADE mu,
ɛsɛ wɔn a wɔtene no sɛ wɔyi no ayɛ.
2 # Dwom 92.3 Momfa sankuo nna AWURADE ase,
momfa sankuo a ɛso homa du nto no dwom!
3 # Dwom 40.3; 96.1; 98.1; Adi 5.9 Monto dwom foforɔ mma no,
mommɔ sankuo yie nka ɛnne ho!
4Na AWURADE asɛm tene,
na ne nnwuma nyinaa wɔ nokorɛ mu.
5Ɔdɔ asɛntenenee ne atemmuo,
AWURADE adɔeɛ ahyɛ asase so ma.
6 # Gye 1.6, 14 AWURADE de n’asɛm na ɛyɛɛ ɔsoro,
na ɔde n’anomu honhom yɛɛ emu asafo nyinaa.
7 # Dwom 104.9 Ɔka ɛpo nsuo boa ano kuo,
ɔde ebunu sie deɛ ɛhɔ dɔ.
8Ma asase nyinaa sofoɔ nsuro AWURADE,
wɔn a wɔte wiase nyinaa mfɛre no;
9na ɔno na ɔka a, ɛba mu,
ɔno na ɔhyɛ a, ɛgyina hɔ.
10AWURADE ma amanaman agyina dane hunu,
ɔma aman adwene yɛ ɔkwa.
11AWURADE agyina deɛ, ɛgyina hɔ daa,
n’akomam adwene wɔ hɔ ma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa.
12 # Deut 33.29 Nhyira ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔn Nyankopɔn ne AWURADE,
ne ɔman a wayi wɔn de ayɛ ɔno ara n’apɛgyadeɛ.
13AWURADE firi soro hwɛ,
ɔhunu nnipa mma nyinaa.
14Ɔte ne tenaberɛ na ɔhwɛ
asase sotefoɔ nyinaa.
15Ɔno na ɔnwono wɔn nyinaa akoma,
ɔhu wɔn nnwuma nyinaa mu.
16 # 1 Sa 17 Ɔhene biara mfa ɛdɔm dodoɔ nni nkonim,
ɔbrane mfa ahoɔden kɛseɛ nnye ne ho.
17 # Dwom 20.7 Nkwagyeɛ mu, ɔpɔnkɔ yɛ ade hunu
na wɔmfa n’ahoɔden dodoɔ nnye onipa.
18 # Dwom 34.15-17 Hwɛ, AWURADE ani wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no so,
ɛwɔ wɔn a wɔn ani da n’adɔeɛ soɔ no so,
19 # Dwom 34.9-10 sɛ ɔbɛgye wɔn kra afiri owuo mu,
na wama wɔanya nkwa ɛkɔm mu.
20 # Dwom 3.3 Yɛn kra twɛn AWURADE,
yɛn boafoɔ ne yɛn kyɛm ne no.
21Na ne mu na yɛn akoma bɛtɔ yɛn yam,
ɛfiri sɛ yɛde yɛn ho ato ne din kronkron so.
22AWURADE, ma w’adɔeɛ ntena yɛn so,
sɛdeɛ yɛn ani da wo soɔ no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ateneneefoɔ, momfa anigyeɛ nhuro AWURADE mu,
ɛsɛ wɔn a wɔtene no sɛ wɔyi no ayɛ.
Momfa sankuo nna AWURADE ase,
momfa sankuo a ɛso homa du nto no dwom!
Monto dwom foforɔ mma no,
mommɔ sankuo yie nka ɛnne ho!
Na AWURADE asɛm tene,
na ne nnwuma nyinaa wɔ nokorɛ mu.
Ɔdɔ asɛntenenee ne atemmuo,
AWURADE adɔeɛ ahyɛ asase so ma.
AWURADE de n’asɛm na ɛyɛɛ ɔsoro,
na ɔde n’anomu honhom yɛɛ emu asafo nyinaa.
Ɔka ɛpo nsuo boa ano kuo,
ɔde ebunu sie deɛ ɛhɔ dɔ.
Ma asase nyinaa sofoɔ nsuro AWURADE,
wɔn a wɔte wiase nyinaa mfɛre no;
na ɔno na ɔka a, ɛba mu,
ɔno na ɔhyɛ a, ɛgyina hɔ.
AWURADE ma amanaman agyina dane hunu,
ɔma aman adwene yɛ ɔkwa.
AWURADE agyina deɛ, ɛgyina hɔ daa,
n’akomam adwene wɔ hɔ ma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa.
Nhyira ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔn Nyankopɔn ne AWURADE,
ne ɔman a wayi wɔn de ayɛ ɔno ara n’apɛgyadeɛ.
AWURADE firi soro hwɛ,
ɔhunu nnipa mma nyinaa.
Ɔte ne tenaberɛ na ɔhwɛ
asase sotefoɔ nyinaa.
Ɔno na ɔnwono wɔn nyinaa akoma,
ɔhu wɔn nnwuma nyinaa mu.
Ɔhene biara mfa ɛdɔm dodoɔ nni nkonim,
ɔbrane mfa ahoɔden kɛseɛ nnye ne ho.
Nkwagyeɛ mu, ɔpɔnkɔ yɛ ade hunu
na wɔmfa n’ahoɔden dodoɔ nnye onipa.
Hwɛ, AWURADE ani wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no so,
ɛwɔ wɔn a wɔn ani da n’adɔeɛ soɔ no so,
sɛ ɔbɛgye wɔn kra afiri owuo mu,
na wama wɔanya nkwa ɛkɔm mu.
Yɛn kra twɛn AWURADE,
yɛn boafoɔ ne yɛn kyɛm ne no.
Na ne mu na yɛn akoma bɛtɔ yɛn yam,
ɛfiri sɛ yɛde yɛn ho ato ne din kronkron so.
AWURADE, ma w’adɔeɛ ntena yɛn so,
sɛdeɛ yɛn ani da wo soɔ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
